note: Frontier release radar: expected upcoming models + market-implied odds, adversarially verified against real markets/announcements.

items.basis: Reported Jul 17 GA target, now ~3 days out; full rebuild (2M context + Deep Think) but still no model card, API listing or price. 'Gemini flagship by Jul 31' markets sit 71-81%.
Polymarket ~84.5% next Opus ships by Jul 31 (91.5% by Aug 31); Anthropic's ~94% best-model-July odds rest partly on a summer flagship refresh landing on cadence.
Polymarket ~92% GPT-6 ships by year-end (73% by Sep 30); OpenAI took the GPT-5.6 family broadly public Jul 9, keeping the next-gen clock live but not accelerated.
Market ~43% Grok 5 before Sep 2026; xAI (now SpaceXAI-branded) shipped Grok 4.5 on Jul 8, so the numbered jump is next but undated.
V4-Pro/Flash preview already out; a wider GA or R2 reasoning line rumored for summer around a reported Jul 24 developer deadline, no dated market.
Mistral Large 3 shipped Dec 2025; a dedicated reasoning variant expected in H2, no confirmed date or market.
